The '''Outland Regions Security Force''', abbreviated '''ORSF''' and sometimes arrogantly referred to as the '''Republic Navy''' by its members,<ref name="Warfare" /> was the [[Planetary Security Forces|local defence force]] established by [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] in the last decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The armed force was established to rein in the lawless regions in the Outer Rim<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> and was formed by [[Governor-General/Legends|Governor-General]] [[Ranulph Tarkin/Legends|Ranulph Tarkin]] of the [[Seswenna sector/Legends|Seswenna sector]] from the [[Seswenna Defense Forces]] and the Planetary Security Forces of neighboring [[Sector/Legends|sectors]].<ref name="Warfare" />

==History==
===Formation===
[[File:Ranulf_Tarkin.jpg|thumb|left|150px|[[Ranulph Tarkin/Legends|Ranulph Tarkin]], founder of the ORSF, overseeing work at a [[Quintad Orbital Manufacturing|QOM]] [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyard]].]]
The [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformations]] disbanded the Republic's centralized armed forces and set limits on the strength of the [[Planetary Security Forces]]. During the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the Galactic Republic, much of the Outer Rim being effectively abandoned to lawlessness and instability. The crumbling of order concentrated power in the region's most populous and prosperous systems, of which [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]] in the [[Seswenna sector/Legends|Seswenna sector]] was the most powerful. Dominated by the [[Quintad/Legends|Quintad]], five powerful families which included the [[Tarkin family/Legends|Tarkins]], Eriadu became an industrial powerhouse and the headquarters of [[Quintad Orbital Manufacturing]] (QOM), a major military shipbuilding corporation.<ref name="Warfare" />

By [[57 BBY/Legends|57 BBY]], QOM was led by [[Ranulph Tarkin/Legends|Ranulph Tarkin]], a fifty-year-old veteran of the [[Seswenna Defense Forces]] who had led a successful campaign against the [[Delmaasi pirates/Legends|Delmaasi pirates]] in [[66 BBY/Legends|66 BBY]] before his business career. Tarkin was alarmed by the breakdown of order across the Outer Rim, and turned over control of QOM to [[Ranulph Tarkin's cousin|his cousin]] to return to his military career. At Tarkin's urging, Seswenna's [[Senator/Legends|senator]], [[Ulm Brashere]], convinced the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Thoris Darus]] to appoint him [[Governor-General/Legends|Governor-General]] of the [[Sector/Legends|sector]], responsible for its defense forces.<ref name="Warfare" />

Given his wish, the now-General Tarkin began to strengthen Seswenna's military capabilities by building new warships in QOM's own facilities, but this soon fell afoul of the Ruusan Reformations' restrictions on [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]] strength and size and earned Tarkin the unwelcome attention of [[Judicial Forces/Legends|Judicial Forces]] inspectors. Frustrated, Tarkin turned to other shipbuilding companies with which QOM had forged ties, striking lend-lease deals that placed dozens of foreign-made [[Corvette/Legends|corvettes]], [[Frigate/Legends|frigates]] and [[Cruiser/Legends|cruisers]] under Eriadu's control. Such "[[demonstration fleet]]s" were common in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]], but Tarkin's ambitions in the Rim alarmed the Judicials, and his next actions did nothing to allay their fears: Tarkin struck mutual-defense pacts with neighboring sectors, trading economic assistance for agreements to combine military forces in times of need, share navigational data among their Planetary Security Forces, and treat their sectors as a single theater of operations known as the [[Greater Seswenna/Legends|Greater Seswenna]]. Tarkin then looked further afield, seeking agreements with other sectors to exchange navigational data and allow safe passage by mutual consent. At a stroke, Tarkin had turned a disorganized collection of Planetary Security Forces into a regional military power, which he proclaimed the Republic Outland Regions Security Force.<ref name="Warfare" />

===Controversy===
The ORSF's rapid expansion bred fears on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] of empire-building. Outraged by accusations of disloyalty, Tarkin stood down as Governor-General in place of his cousin [[Garvedon]] and was elected Seswenna's senator in [[54 BBY/Legends|54 BBY]]. As the Seswenna sector's representative to Coruscant, Tarkin became an articulate proponent of enhancing the Republic's military capabilities, using the Outland Regions Security Force as a model. His feud with the [[Judicial Department/Legends|Judicial Department]] continued, though the ORSF had many sympathizers within the Judicial Forces, and all the while Tarkin swore that he would turn over control of the ORSF to the Republic government, provided the force was part of a restored, centralized [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]].<ref name="Warfare" />

Tarkin became the leader of the [[Militarists/Legends|Militarist]] faction of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], but the suspicions of his detractors deepened. Senators such as [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]] noted the all-[[Human/Legends|Human]] composition of the ORSF, which struck many as speciesist, and also accused Tarkin of effectively buying the acquiescence of Eriadu's impoverished neighbors, seeing sinister designs in the fact that the ORSF referred to its expanded theater of operations as the [[Greater Seswenna/Legends|Greater Seswenna]]. In reaction, Tarkin and personnel of the ORSF came to refer to their fleet and ground forces as the "Republic Navy" and the "Republic Army," seeing it as a template for a restored force.<ref name="Warfare" />

===The test of battle===
[[File:Tarkin_Paramilitary_Troops.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Troops of Tarkin's paramilitary forces are attacked on the surface of [[Troiken/Legends|Troiken]].]]
{{Main|Stark Hyperspace War/Legends}}
The Outland Regions Security Force was put to the test during the [[Stark Hyperspace War/Legends|Stark Hyperspace War]] of [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]]. The [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Iaco Stark/Legends|Iaco Stark]] had been raiding [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] convoys, intensifying a [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] shortage. Tarkin urged the Judicials to hunt down and destroy Stark, threatening that if they would not, the ORSF would. However, the Senate heeded Finis Valorum's advice instead, calling a peace conference. Tarkin wrung the location of the peace conference, [[Troiken/Legends|Troiken]], out of [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]] of the Trade Federation. To send the ORSF to a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] on the other side of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] from Eriadu would be a major violation of defense fleet mobility regulations, but Tarkin had bet that a major victory over Stark's pirates would make him a hero and override legal concerns.<ref name="Warfare" />

Sympathetic Judicials lent the ORSF several battalions of [[Special forces/Legends|special forces]] assault troops to provide a ground assault force.<ref name="Warfare" /> When the peace conference began, Gunray signaled the ORSF from his [[Mechno-chair/Legends|mechno-chair]], and Tarkin was too eager to analyze the navigational data. Suspecting treachery, however, Iaco Stark had piggybacked Gunray's transmission with a [[navcomputer virus]] known as a [[Tionese program]]. By the time the ORSF mustered, every [[Navigation computer/Legends|navigation computer]] was infected with the virus. Only one-third of the force reached Troiken; another third emerged from [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] off-course, while the last third emerged from hyperspace in places that would destroy them, such as within planets or near [[Black hole/Legends|black holes]] and [[Star/Legends|stars]].<ref name="SWR:TSHW" />

In the ensuing [[First Battle of Qotile]], the fleet was trounced. The survivors went to ground on the surface of Troiken, rescuing Valorum, Gunray, and their [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] escorts and digging in at [[Mount Avos]]. There, the Judicials' [[Special Tactics trooper]]s fought several battles before the siege was lifted with the [[Stark Commercial Combine]]'s defeat by the [[Trade Defense Force]] in the [[Fifth Battle of Qotile]]. Ranulph Tarkin was killed in the fighting, but thereby became a martyr to the Militarist cause.<ref name="SWR:TSHW" /><ref name="Warfare" />

===Legacy===
The Outland Regions Security Force endured after its founder's [[Death/Legends|death]]. Following the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]], the ORSF was reinforced with impounded Trade Federation vessels, including [[Trade Federation cargo hauler|cargo haulers]], [[Captor-class heavy munitions cruiser|heavy munitions cruisers]], [[C-9979 landing craft/Legends|C-9979 landing craft]], [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s, and [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droids]].<ref name="RP" />

In [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]], [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]], Ranulph's nephew and former [[Lieutenant governor/Legends|lieutenant governor]] of Eriadu, held the rank of [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] within the Outland Regions Security Force.<ref name="RP" /> That year, the Security Force launched an [[Second Battle of Zonama Sekot|unsuccessful attack]] on [[Zonama Sekot/Legends|Zonama Sekot]] in an effort to claim a [[Sekotan Personal Starship|Sekotan starship]].<ref name="RP" />

A legacy of the ORSF's expansion under Ranulph Tarkin was revealed a generation later during the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]]. In [[26 BBY/Legends|26 BBY]], it responded half-heartedly to a raid by [[Nocto]] pirates at [[Ochotl]] in the neighboring [[Airam sector/Legends|Airam sector]]. Ochotl was an [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] that was affiliated with the [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]] to better compete with the Eriadu-dominated agricultural firms in [[The Pangarees/Legends|the Pangarees]], and the ORSF's inaction convinced many that it was just a tool of Eriadu's interests. The entire Airam sector thereafter seceded from the Republic and joined the burgeoning [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Likewise, Eriadu's militarism and Tarkin's ambition had pushed its rival [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]] and the Rimward sectors of the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]] towards the CIS.<ref name="Warfare" /><ref name="Author's Cut">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 8: Tales of the Clone Wars}}</ref>

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Eriadu became a besieged Republic salient within Separatist space. The Outland Regions Security Force fought alongside [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] as part of the Republic's [[Eighteenth Army]] under the command of Wilhuff Tarkin, now one of the first [[Moff/Legends|Moffs]], and his younger brother [[Gideon Tarkin|Gideon]]. The Greater Seswenna became the official name of the Eighteenth Army's theater of operations, and the ORSF was deployed in engagements along both the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]] and the Rimma Trade Route in the final actions of the [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|Outer Rim Sieges]].<ref name="Warfare" />

==Organization==
Styling himself a [[General/Legends|General]], Ranulph Tarkin bombastically referred to his fleet as the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] and his ground troops as the [[Republic Army]]; although both had been eliminated by the Ruusan Reformation, his Militarist faction sought to reestablish them.

Tarkin's detractors noted that the ORSF was composed almost entirely of Humans, which struck many as [[Speciesism|speciesist]]. Tarkin insisted that this reflected a concern for unit morale and a desire to standardize systems and procedures.<ref name="Warfare" /> Either by result or intent, most of Tarkin's soldiers agreed with his [[Humanocentrism|Humanocentric]] ideals.

The ORSF's elite soldiers during the Stark Hyperspace War were the [[Special Tactics trooper]]s.

==Personnel==
Tarkin's soldiers, officers, and vehicles and vessels were culled from the regional defense forces of planets sympathetic to his cause, among them [[Rendili/Legends|Rendili]], [[Commenor/Legends|Commenor]], Eriadu, [[Barkhesh/Legends|Barkhesh]], and [[Carida/Legends|Carida]]. Soldiers in the force included [[Antidar Williams/Legends|Antidar Williams]]<ref name="DB" /> and [[Jace Dallin]], the latter of whom served as Ranulph Tarkin's [[Aide/Legends|aide]] and [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]].<ref name="SWR:TSHW" />

[[Maarisa Zsinj]], the mother of future [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] and [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]], served as an [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] in the Outland Regions Security Force and her skills earned her the nickname of "Ace of the Spacelanes."<ref name="Despoilers1" />

==Equipment==
Tarkin's ships were apparently Judicial Forces surplus, and consisted of [[CSS-1 Corellian Star Shuttle/Legends|Corellian Star Shuttles]], [[Consular-class light cruiser/Legends|''Consular''-class space cruisers]], and [[Republic light assault cruiser|variants]] of ''Consular''s built with wider hulls (presumably for carrying ground forces). The fleet's [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], [[Invincible (Stark Hyperspace War)|''Invincible'']], was another modified ''Consular''. The fleet's [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] force was filled by [[A-6 Interceptor]]s. This force mix reflected traditional military thinking that quick and maneuverable weapons platforms could outfight larger [[Warship/Legends|warships]].<ref name="Warfare" />

Tarkin's ground forces' primary weapon was the [[A280 blaster rifle/Legends|A280 blaster rifle]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Outland Regions Security Force was created by [[Greg Bear]] and first featured in the novel ''[[Rogue Planet]]''. The [[2012]] guide book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' later [[Retroactive continuity|retconned]] a Republic-affiliated paramilitary force that appeared in the [[2001]] comic arc ''[[Star Wars: The Stark Hyperspace War]]'' as being the Outland Regions Security Force.
